text: This might be a silly one but I'd rather ask. I'm stepdad to a 10 year old boy, he's been under the weather since yesterday with a sore throat. He's still drinking fine, been through a couple of cups of tea with honey and plenty of water, so I wasn't too worried about that side of it. Temp was 38.4 just now. The thing that's bugging me is when I helped him change his top I noticed some little dots on his chest and a couple on his arm, tiny like pinpricks, sort of dark reddish purple. His mum mentioned once about pressing a glass on spots so I tried it and they're still there, you can see them clearly through the glass, they don't go away at all. They might have been there before and I just didn't notice, I honestly don't know. He says he's alright other than his throat. His mum's away for work so I'm second guessing myself here. Is this something or am I overthinking it
